# llms.txt Builder

> Free online generator that creates spec-correct llms.txt files, with a plain-English guide to the llms.txt standard. Fill a form, get a valid file, upload it to your web root.

## Tool

- [Builder](/): Interactive form with live preview. Copy or download the generated llms.txt.
- [Guide](/#guide): What llms.txt is, the exact format, who uses it, and how it differs from robots.txt and sitemap.xml.

## Sister sites

- AgentLens (worker: createjob): Free AI visibility scanner — verify your site after uploading llms.txt.
- AgentFront (worker: agentfront): Agent-native storefront template for agentic commerce.
